summary: The main change was swapping the three demo opportunities with named real companies—'Cloud Migration - Weis Markets', 'ERP Rollout - VSE Corporation', and 'Consulting Retainer - Insteel Industries'—and expanding the task to seed 22 additional pipeline records, for 25 total opportunities, all described as sourced from real public-company filings (SEC EDGAR 10-K) plus published deal-size benchmarks.
bullets: Replaced fake leads Hyperion/Zenith/Apex with Weis Markets/VSE Corporation/Insteel Industries, plus 22 background opportunities for 25 total CRM records.
Named sources: SEC EDGAR 10-K filings for 25 public companies; Flexera 2024, Panorama Consulting 2023, IBIS World 2023, Gartner 2023.
Touched deal scales: target revenues became $87,900, $215,000, and $96,000; background opportunities range from $47,500 to $247,500.
Setup script now deletes old demo records, recreates stages/tags/lost reasons, and seeds varied shorthand, blank, stale, and multi-paragraph notes.
Exporter, verifier, task text, validated PI, and VLM checklist were all renamed to the new companies and expected actions.
Missed part: it did not ingest external messy datasets or cite URLs; records remain scripted from real company names and benchmarked amounts.
addressed_reason: It clearly moved away from obvious fake/demo company names and added more production-like scale and messiness with real-world source references. But it still appears to hand-seed synthetic CRM records rather than importing actual messy data from external sources, and it does not provide concrete source URLs.
